en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European industrial town nestled in a valley with forested hills in the background. In the foreground are farmhouses and small industrial buildings with pitched roofs and a tall factory smokestack. Further back, there is a row of multi‑story residential houses following a curving road or river. The scene shows a mix of rural fields, scattered trees, and compact town buildings, typical of an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century industrial settlement.
